constraint_text: The answer must be obtained by invoking the provided tools and must include at least one interaction turn in which at least two unique tool types are invoked simultaneously; in particular, any invocation of train_speed_analyzer must occur in the same interaction turn as an invocation of landmark_information_retriever. The full solution must be derived within at most 10 interaction turns. The answer must be presented in a tabular format with two columns, "Entity" and "Value", separated by a delimiter such as a comma or tab, and the final response must end with a period.
